How statuses work
Due means a scheduled direct-recall fact is ready for review, even if that topic is currently switched off. Games add weighted mastery evidence without changing the spaced-review clock. Weak and Strong use both direct recall and gameplay evidence; Mastered still requires sustained clean retrieval over time.

What are steps?

Every time you play or study, you take steps forward. Your daily goal keeps track of them.

One answered question, map target, ranked place or finished Borderless round counts as a step. A completed Detective case counts as one step too.

Obvious capital cities & other names
Allow names that give away the country—for example, Mexico City → Mexico or Kuwaiti dinar → Kuwait. Also includes other city and language names. Applies to Quiz and supported games; Flash cards are unchanged.
Label language samples
Show a language’s name beside its writing sample in Quiz. The “Obvious clues” setting above controls whether giveaway language names can be chosen at all.
Haptic feedback
Light vibration for answers and goal completion.

Privacy & data
How your data is usedStorage, backups and what you choose to share.

GeoDen private beta · Updated 15 October 2026.

Your optional name, study progress, answers used for review, preferences and cached facts are stored in this browser on this device. GeoDen has no account system, advertising or analytics. Clearing browser data removes these records. Export a backup in Settings before switching devices or browsers.

Flags and maps are bundled with this build. Daily Ranking’s population, area and density puzzles use a bundled World Bank World Development Indicators snapshot retrieved 10 October 2026 (CC BY 4.0): population and surface area. Regular Ranking still requests current values when available.

When online, GeoDen requests live country facts from Wikidata. Wikidata receives the requested country identifiers and ordinary connection information, including your IP address; GeoDen does not include your name or study history in these requests. See Wikimedia’s privacy policy. A hosted copy is also subject to the hosting provider’s request logging.

Problem reports stay in memory until you choose to copy, download or share them. They include recent app actions, game context, errors and browser/screen details, plus anything you type in the description. They omit your saved profile name and a full storage backup. Review what you send and avoid including private information.

If you email feedback to Cayden Jansen at caydenjansen2@gmail.com, your email address and message are received through Gmail and used to investigate your feedback. You can request deletion of feedback by emailing the same address.

Reset progress removes study records while retaining preferences. Remove your optional name in Personalisation, or clear this site’s browser data to remove all local records. Copies you export or email must be deleted separately.

Importing a backup asks before replacing your saved data and keeps one copy of the previous data on this device. Download that copy to undo the import. Reset progress or clearing this site’s browser data also removes that recovery copy.

Maps: Natural Earth via world-atlas; Borderless lakes from Natural Earth 1:50m; high-detail boundaries © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License, packaged by geo-maps. Flags: Flagpedia / FlagCDN. Library notices are included in this download.
